title: Pickleball Smash
style: Jazz swing big band with a 1970s showband pulse, syncopated upright bass, brushed kit, bright trumpet punches, and Spanish guitar licks weaving through the horns; verse rides sly cabaret swing, pre-chorus strips to bass and snaps, chorus hits with stacked female vocals, shouty brass stabs, and a rubbery call-and-response hook. Add risers into each turn, short trumpet fills between lines, and a glossy, punchy mix with wide horn spread and close-mic lead, jazz, pop, big band, swing
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Michelle, Mishy, mish mash
Court shoes, white slash
I took a hard hit down
Black truck, right leg, bad

Can walk, can’t run
Still I serve for fun
Tennis pro, now flip
Watch me make that switch

[Pre-Chorus]
Lean on the left
Set the feet, don’t rush
Eyes on the bounce
Soft hands, then hush

[Chorus]
Pickle ball smash
Bee bop, bee bop
Pickle ball smash
Pop that shot

Pickle ball smash
Mishy, swing back
Pickle ball smash
Pop that shot

[Verse 2]
Dink it short, make ’em lean
Cross-court kiss, low and clean
Kitchen line, don’t flinch
Little tap, big win

Open face, block the speed
Reset soft when they speed
Serve wide, pull ’em out
Then I take that route

[Pre-Chorus]
Bend, don’t break
Weight on the good side
Hear that crowd
When the ball flies

[Chorus]
Pickle ball smash
Bee bop, bee bop
Pickle ball smash
Pop that shot

Pickle ball smash
Mishy, swing back
Pickle ball smash
Pop that shot

[Bridge]
Spanish licks in the air
Horn line, cut right there
I’m bruised, I’m still game
Call my name, call my name

Right leg, bad day
Still I find a way
From pro to pro
Watch me go, go, go

[Final Chorus]
Pickle ball smash
Bee bop, bee bop
Pickle ball smash
Pop that shot

Pickle ball smash
Michelle on fire
Pickle ball smash
Pop that shot

Pickle ball smash
Mishy, swing back
Pickle ball smash
Pop that shot
